    def route_load(route):
        l = 0
        for c in route:
            l += demands[c]
        return l

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes if r)

    def two_opt(route):
        m = len(route)

            return route
        best_route = route
        best = route_cost(best_route)

            base = best

                        improved = True
                        break

def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = set(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    nbh = instance.get("nearest_neighbors", {}) or {}

    # Helpers
    def route_load(route):
        l = 0
        for c in route:
            l += demands[c]
        return l

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes if r)

    # Intra-route 2-opt (deterministic first improvement)
    def two_opt(route):
        m = len(route)
        if m < 4:
            return route
        best_route = route
        best = route_cost(best_route)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            base = best
            for i in range(m - 1):
                a = best_route[i]
                b = best_route[i + 1]
                for j in range(i + 2, m - 1):
                    c = best_route[j]
                    d = best_route[j + 1]
                    # Replace (a-b) and (c-d) with (a-c) and (b-d)
                    new_cost = base - matrix[a][b] - matrix[c][d] + matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    if new_cost < base:
                        best_route = best_route[:i + 1] + best_route[i + 1:j + 1][::-1] + best_route[j + 1:]
                        best = new_cost
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
            m = len(best_route)
        return best_route

    # Inter-route relocate: move a single customer to best feasible end position
    def relocate(routes, route_loads, route_costs):
        num = len(routes)
        if num <= 1:
            return routes, route_loads, route_costs, False

        # Map customer -> (route_index, position)
        pos = {}
        for ri, r in enumerate(routes):
            for pi, c in enumerate(r):
                pos[c] = (ri, pi)

        improved_any = False
        # Process customers in deterministic order (insertion position order)
        for c in sorted(customers):
            if c not in pos:
                continue
            ri, pi = pos[c]
            src = routes[ri]
            if pi < 0 or pi >= len(src):
                continue

            # Remove c from src (we only allow removing internal node as well)
            # Try insert c into each other route at best ends only (more stable)
            # Compute best feasible gain; relocate into single best target per c.
            best_gain = 0
            best_target = None  # (rj, side) side 0=front,1=back, and maybe adjust
            # Cost delta for removing from src
            left = src[pi - 1] if pi - 1 >= 0 else depot
            mid = src[pi]
            right = src[pi + 1] if pi + 1 < len(src) else depot
            remove_delta = -matrix[left][mid] - matrix[mid][right] + matrix[left][right]
